mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_MESSAGE ( MESSAGE_KEY, ROOM_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENDER_USER_KEY, MESSAGE_CONTENT, FILE_KEY ) VALUES ( #{messageKey}, #{roomKey}, #{messageType}, #{senderUserKey}, #{messageContent}, #{fileKey} )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT M.MESSAGE_KEY AS messageKey, M.ROOM_KEY AS roomKey, M.MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType, M.SENDER_USER_KEY AS senderUserKey, M.MESSAGE_CONTENT AS messageContent, M.FILE_KEY AS fileKey, M.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, M.DELETED_YN AS deletedYn,
U.USER_NICKNAME AS senderNickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM_USER RU WHERE RU.ROOM_KEY = M.ROOM_KEY AND RU.EXITED_AT IS NULL ) - ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CHAT_MESSAGE_READ MR WHERE MR.MESSAGE_KEY = M.MESSAGE_KEY ) - 1
AS readCount
FROM TB_CHAT_MESSAGE M
INNER JOIN TB_USER_MST U ON M.SENDER_USER_KEY = U.USER_KEY
WHERE M.ROOM_KEY = #{roomKey} AND M.DELETED_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC
LIMIT 30
) T
ORDER BY T.createdAt ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST SET LAST_MESSAGE_KEY = #{messageKey}, LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT = #{messageContent}, LAST_MESSAGE_AT = NOW() WHERE ROOM_KEY = #{roomKey}
mapper.select:

U.USER_NICKNAME AS senderNickname,
